description: Buy tickets from a get_ticket_listings listing (event_id, uvid, quantity) on XP. Two calls: confirm=false returns a preview with the all-in total; confirm=true, once the person approves, completes the order and returns its order_uuid. Four payment rails, chosen with rail: 'stripe_link' (the default) pays by card on a Stripe-hosted checkout page, where the preview returns payment_link and checkout_session_id and confirm=true takes that checkout_session_id; 'privy' pays USDC from the person's XP wallet, signed by the server; 'x402' takes a Solana USDC payment the caller signs, passed as payment_proof; 'mpp' pays by card with a Stripe Shared Payment Token over the Machine Payments Protocol, sent in params._meta['org.paymentauth/credential'] or as payment_credential. Requires sign-in and the write:tickets scope, plus read:account for the balance check on 'privy'.

checkout_session_id.description: rail='stripe_link' only, with confirm=true. The checkout_session_id returned by the preview.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute. False returns a preview only.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_events or get_event_details.

facilitator.description: rail='x402' only. Id from facilitators_available in the preview envelope; omit to use the deploy default. Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.

payment_credential.description: rail='mpp' only. JSON MPP credential, as a fallback for clients that cannot send params._meta. Prefer _meta when available.

payment_proof.description: Required only for rail='x402' when confirm=True. Base64-encoded x402 v2 PaymentPayload (SVM 'exact') containing a partially-signed Solana USDC TransferChecked transaction.

rail.description: Payment rail. 'stripe_link' (default) to pay by card on a Stripe-hosted Checkout page: the preview returns payment_link and checkout_session_id; after the user pays, confirm with checkout_session_id. 'privy' for server-signed delegate USDC. 'x402' for agent-signed Solana x402 payment with payment_proof. 'mpp' to pay with a Stripe Shared Payment Token over the MPP binding.
